properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6 v7 v8

verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Gwe wali lwazi lwabwe-oluwanvu,
Omugabe mu lutalo lwabwe,
Ggwe wabamulisa mu nzikiza
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Naffe-abaserikale bo leero,
Tweragenga-amasajja nga bali;
Naffe tutikkirwe engule eri
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Fenna tussekimu wamu nabo
Ffe-abakyalwana ne be watwala
-Okubeera naawe mu kitiibwa kyo
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Era oluusi bwe tukoowa-ennyo
Tuguma-omwoyo nga tuwulira
-Oluvimba lwabwe olw'olujaguza.
Aleruuya, Aleruuya!

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Obudde bunaatera-oktuuka,
Ne tuwummulira wamu nabo
Mu nnimiro z'okwesiima ziri.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Laba! ate obudde bwe bukya
Abatukuvu ne bazuukira
Kabaka-ow'ekitiibwa ng'atuuse.
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!

verse.name: v8
verse.lines:
Bava mu nkuzi zonna ez'ensi,
Nga bayimba okutendereza
Katonda oli-omu mu Busatu
Aleruuya,Aleruuya!
